root.description: Root directory to use instead of / when repacking; useful for repacking from a chroot or mounted filesystem.

arch.description: Architecture to force for the repacked package (e.g., amd64, arm64). Omit if using the installed package's architecture.

deb_options.description: List of options to pass directly to dpkg-deb during .deb building (e.g., ['-Zgzip', '-z9']). Each item is a string argument to --deb-option=.

generate.description: If true, only generate a temporary package directory without building the .deb file.

tag.description: Comma-separated list of tagging options (e.g., 'version', 'description', 'none', 'all'); overrides default 'description' tagging if specified.

packages.description: List of package names to repack (e.g., ['curl', 'openssh-server']). Required; at least one package must be listed.
